summary: cto checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: CTO review: approve only bounded updates to the three existing execution, failure-containment, and measurement work items. Do not create new proposals, change_requests, telemetry, dependencies, spend, schedules, permissions, credentials, launch changes, or production work. Preserve unknown revenue, cost, margin, attribution, incrementality, causal lift, and operational-health fields. Keep existing work-item ownership unchanged.

Update the existing execution sprint only: reconcile approved work against queued, active, deployed, cancelled, and failed records using existing records. Do not requeue or create implementation requests unless deduplication, ownership, validation, rollback, and queue eligibility are documented.

Update the existing failure-containment work only: review retained failure artifacts, deduplicate repairs, document root cause, isolated validation, rollback, and explicit requeue-or-close disposition. No new production implementation or requeue is authorized before those controls are evidenced.

Update the existing measurement-gates work only: use available impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, site-attributed commission, and already-available AI cost. Do not request duplicate telemetry or infer infrastructure cost, labor cost, conversion value, contribution margin, ROI, incrementality, causal lift, or cost-to-learn. Keep gated launches private and preserve existing measurement windows.
